text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said analyst Andrew Jeffrey initiated coverage of Anicom Inc with a long-term attractive rating.
-- Anicom is a leading distributor of communication and security-related wire, cable, fiber optics, computer network and connectivity products. The stock was unchanged at 9-3/4.

-- "It is our opinion that Anicom is among the largest specialized competitors in this market. The company is a pure-play distribution story, with no plans to expand into manufacturing or other ancillary businesses, which we believe supports the stock's multiple and capitalizes on the strengths of senior management," Jeffrey said. The EPS estimates for 1996 and 1997 are $0.20 and $0.29, respectively.
